notes: New on the Strategy tab: model a 0% balance transfer offer. Tick the balances you're thinking of moving, enter the offer's 0% period, fee and post-promo rate, and see what it works out to for your debts - with the transfer fee counted in.

It answers the question that actually matters: would you clear the balance before the 0% period ends? If not, it shows how much would still be owed when the rate jumps, and what happens if your extra payment stopped along the way.
